title: Salmon with quinoa and broccoli
summary: Omega-3 rich and high in protein.
steps: Rinse the quinoa in a sieve, then simmer it covered in twice its volume of salted water for 15 minutes, until the water is absorbed. Leave it covered for 5 minutes and fluff it with a fork.
Heat the oven to 200 °C. Put the salmon on a lined tray, season it and add lemon slices and herbs. Roast for 12 to 15 minutes, until it flakes easily and is no longer see-through in the middle.
Cut the broccoli into florets and steam or boil them for 4 to 5 minutes, until bright green and just tender.
Serve the salmon on the quinoa with the broccoli, and drizzle the olive oil over the top.
